methodology.order: All six permutations of the three modes repeat equally; lane order reverses on alternate rounds.
methodology.timer: performance.now around spawnSync, in milliseconds; includes fresh process startup, native file read, parsing, execution, full JSON serialization and stdout capture. Fixture preparation, file writing and JS comparison are outside timing.
methodology.processModel: Every sample is a fresh process. Warmups warm OS caches; no persistent native process/state and no cache eviction.
methodology.comparison: Every invocation is checked against all three full outputs in its round and the first baseline output, after changing only schemaVersion 2 to 1; retained status, gas, blob gas and every receipt are also checked.
methodology.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; standard deviation is population standard deviation.
methodology.lockMethod: Automatic flock -F wrapper, shared with cooperating Lean builds; does not isolate unrelated host activity.
methodology.exclusions: Warmups are retained in raw rows and excluded from distributions. No measured outliers are discarded.

scope: Two small synthetic fixtures from the pinned retained list corpus, on one shared host. These are process-inclusive observations of an experimental executor, not client throughput, execution-component timings, scalability, cryptographic refinement or a consensus-performance guarantee. No Geth/EthereumJS execution is rerun; independent libraries only prepare/check fixture proofs outside timing.
